entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Ah, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. How
kind
of
you
to
stop by.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_01

entries.text:
I must say, I am pleased to see you on school
grounds again.\c
Travel and adventure certainly have their place,
but it does one good to attend class as well, no?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_02

entries.text: Speaking of which, there is something I would\nvery much like to ask you...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_03

entries.text:
I understand you have joined a variety of classes
during your time here at the academy.\c
But, if I may ask, which of our faculty members
has made the most favorable impression on you?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_04

entries.text: Mr. Jacq
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_select_01

entries.text: Ms. Tyme
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_select_02

entries.text: Ms. Raifort
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_select_03

entries.text: Mr. Salvatore
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_select_04

entries.text: Ms. Dendra
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_select_05

entries.text: Mr. Hassel
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_select_06

entries.text: Mr. Saguaro
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_select_07

entries.text: Nurse Miriam
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_select_08

entries.text: Director Clavell
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_select_09

entries.text: Oho. Mr. Jacq from biology class, you say?\c\nYes, he is a fine teacher. A most earnest and\nhardworking fellow.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_05_01

entries.text: Oho. Ms. Tyme from math class, you say?\c\nYes, she is a fine teacher. A most warm and\npeaceable woman.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_05_02

entries.text: Oho. Ms. Raifort from history class, you say?\c\nYes, she is a fine teacher—extremely discerning\nin her interests.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_05_03

entries.text: Oho. Mr. Salvatore from language class, you say?\c\nYes, he is a fine teacher. A most sociable and\noutgoing fellow.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_05_04

entries.text: Oho. Ms. Dendra from battle class, you say?\c\nYes, she is a fine teacher. A most upbeat and\ncheerful woman.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_05_05

entries.text: Oho. Mr. Hassel from art class, you say?\c\nYes, he is a fine teacher. A most passionate and\nenthusiastic fellow.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_05_06

entries.text:
Oho. Mr. Saguaro from home economics class,
you say?\c
Yes, he is a fine teacher. A most calm and
collected fellow.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_05_07

entries.text: Oho. Nurse Miriam, you say?\c\nYes, she is a fine practitioner of medicine. A most\nkind and gentle soul.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_05_08

entries.text:
M-me?! Are you quite sure?\c
I suspect some element of diplomacy may be at
work here, but if that is indeed how you feel...
then I am most happy to hear it.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_05_09

entries.text: We are truly blessed to have so many wonderful\nteachers and staff members at Naranja Academy.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_06a

entries.text: We are truly blessed to have so many wonderful\nteachers and staff members at Uva Academy.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_06b

entries.text: I firmly believe that our faculty is second to none\nin their commitment to our students’ ongoing\r\neducation and well-being.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_07

entries.text: Thank you very much for sharing your thoughts,\nM[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_08

entries.text: You became even closer with Director Clavell!
entries.label: kizuna_head_b_system_01
